highlights: Full-time Counseling Department for student support
Obligated reporting procedures for staff members regarding mistreatment or neglect
Adherence to Thai Legal Framework including the Child Protection Act 2003
safety.policy_summary: Wells International School implements a comprehensive Child Protection and Safeguarding Policy aligned with Thai law, obligating all staff members to monitor, report, and address any suspicion of child abuse, neglect, or mistreatment to designated administrators and counseling departments.
